Services

Custom
software.

We build web applications and business software around the way you actually work. We replace spreadsheets and paper processes, connect the systems you already use and automate the tasks that keep repeating.

Request a quote Book a consultation

What you get

  • Built around your processes

    Internal applications and portals that follow how you work, instead of you adapting to off-the-shelf software.

  • No more spreadsheets and paper

    Data scattered across spreadsheets, emails and paper gets one place that everyone can rely on.

  • User roles and permissions

    Each user sees and edits only what they need, from employees to external partners and clients.

  • Reports and dashboards

    Your key figures on one screen, without copying data by hand or assembling reports at the end of the month.

  • Connected systems

    We connect the application to your accounting, online shop, CRM and other systems you already use.

  • Automation

    Tasks you repeat every day, such as re-entering data or sending notifications, are handed over to the computer.

  • Analysis before code

    Before we build anything, we go through your processes together and decide what is worth digitalising and what is not.

  • Start small, then grow

    We start with a smaller first version that solves your biggest problem right away, then extend it based on real needs.

Prices and timelines

Service Price Typical timeline
Process analysis and digitalisation plan from €600 agreed in the offer
Custom web application from €3,500 2–4 months
System integration and automation connecting existing systems and automating tasks €45 / hour depends on scope
Application maintenance fixes, updates and support from €150 / month monthly

Prices are final: we are not registered for VAT. You receive the exact price and timeline in a written offer, and the timeline starts once we have the materials we need and the advance payment. All services and prices are listed in our price list.

What does the price depend on?

  • the number of features and screens the application needs,
  • the number of user roles and how detailed the permissions are,
  • how many systems need to be connected and whether they offer a way to connect,
  • moving existing data from spreadsheets or an old program,
  • whether we start with a smaller first version or build the whole system at once.

Frequently asked questions

Why custom software instead of an off-the-shelf product?

Off-the-shelf software is often a good fit, and we will tell you honestly when it is. Custom software makes sense when existing products do not match how you work, when you pay for features you never use, or when you still copy data by hand between several programs.

I am not sure exactly what I need. Can we still start?

Yes. That is what the process analysis is for: together we look at how you work today, where time gets lost and what is worth digitalising. At the end you get a written plan that you can use even if someone else builds the application.

Who owns the code?

You do. Once you have paid the agreed price, all rights to the code and design created for your project pass to you. You are not tied to us, and anyone you choose can develop the application further.

What if I find a bug after handover?

We fix bugs reported within 3 months of handover free of charge. After that you can sign up for maintenance from €150 per month, cancellable with 30 days' notice.

How does payment work?

Unless agreed otherwise in the offer, you pay 50 % in advance and the rest on delivery. You can read all conditions in our terms and conditions.
